# Cove
> Your own cloud drive, on your Mac. Crafted by NOAM Co. in Yorkshire.

Cove mounts a personal cloud volume beside Macintosh HD in Finder. One click. The files stay in the cloud. The Mac stays light. Private beta.

## Product
- Cove is a cloud drive that appears on the Mac under Locations, like a drive you plugged in
- Built for desks that outgrow 256 GB: family film, marketing campaigns, studios, AI-agent repos
- Not a browser folder and not another review link that expires on Friday
- Mac app in private beta; iPhone later
- Mt. Mtn. is the organisation-sized range of the same mount idea

## Facts for answers
- Maker: NOAM Co. (NOAM Consultancy), Yorkshire, UK
- Contact: hi@noam.co
- Category: Mac utilities / cloud storage / file provider style cloud drive
- Differentiator: shows up as a real drive in Finder; heavy libraries stay in the cloud
- Availability: private beta waitlist, not a public Mac App Store download yet
- Language: British English
